risk: Reject new simulated exposure when realized gain minus pending stakes is <= -10 u. At realized gain <= -10 u, stop this version permanently; settle already logged tickets. This is a budget rule, not statistical proof.
review: 50 settled bets: diagnostic only, no tuning. One final performance decision on the first 100 published bets after all settle, or at the 24-month deadline; fewer than 100 means insufficient evidence and closure without promotion.
abandonment: Stop at the loss budget, irreparable data/model integrity issue, nonpositive gain after 2% worse odds at final review, or final one-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound <=0. Otherwise close unconfirmed if promotion criteria are not all met.
confirmation: 100 settled nonvoid bets; >=25 bets in each of >=2 seasons; positive stressed gain and positive gain without largest win; one-sided weekly bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; closing quotes available on >=80% of bets and positive mean entry/closing odds -1. Approximate inference, not a guarantee.
integrity: One fixture only; all accepted/rejected decisions logged before kickoff; quote observed <= decision, decision < kickoff; latest feature availability <= decision; real named bookmaker, executable price (not an average); frozen model hashes; unchanged filter; immutable originals.
excluded: All pre-26-October tickets, retrospective simulations, English bets and old filter versions remain outside this new confirmation cohort.
